title: Iziaslav
summary: Iziaslav refers to multiple subjects related to Ukraine, including a city and a former administrative region, as well as notable historical figures. The name is significant within the context of Ukrainian history and geography.

sections.heading: Iziaslav, Ukraine
paragraphs: Iziaslav is a city located [[coal-in-ukraine|in Ukraine]], known for its historical and cultural significance.

sections.heading: Iziaslav Raion
paragraphs: Iziaslav Raion was a former administrative district in [[khmelnytskyi-oblast|Khmelnytskyi Oblast]], [[ukraine|Ukraine]], which played a role in the regional governance of the area.

sections.heading: Historical Figures
paragraphs: Iziaslav IV Vladimirovich, born in 1186, is one of the notable historical figures associated with the name Iziaslav, contributing to the history of the region.

Additionally, Iziaslav (Brutskiy), who lived from 1926 to 2007, served as the primate of the Belarusian Autocephalous Orthodox Church, indicating the broader cultural and religious connections of the name.

sections.heading: Disambiguation
paragraphs: The term Iziaslav also encompasses various individuals, including those referred to as Iziaslav of Kiev, highlighting the name's historical prevalence in [[history-of-ukraine|Ukrainian history]].
